name: vscode-cucumber-js-runner
description: Cucumber JS Test Runner for VS Code

cucumberJsRunner.cliArgs.markdownDescription:
The `cucumberJsRunner.cliArgs` setting defines arguments that will be passed to the `cucumber-js` command.
Default value:
```json
{
  "cucumberJsRunner.cliArgs": []
}
```

cucumberJsRunner.cwd.markdownDescription: The `cucumberJsRunner.cwd` setting defines the current working directory for the `cucumber-js` command. The first workspace folder will be used if not specified.
